name: Estefania Zambrana — additional son Ricardo (b. 1874)
researcher_question: Did Estefania Zambrana and her husband Antonio Beisaga of Cochabamba, Bolivia have a son named Ricardo, baptized 1874, in addition to their two known children (b. 1867 and 1877)?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 7, flag adds_son, confidence 3). RESOLVED (issue #857): FALSE MATCH (insufficient evidence) - the 1874 Santo Domingo (Cochabamba) baptism of Ricardo names parents 'Antonio Veizaga'/'Estefania Zambrana' but is the only record naming Ricardo; no marriage of this couple could be located, the tree's 1877 Geronimo baptism does not link him, and surname variation (Beisaga/Beizaga/Veizaga) alone does not prove identity, so the hint does not meet the GPS. A Cowork agent's probable-true-match reading relied on an 1870 marriage that could not be found. expected-findings.json is a polarity:avoid guard + a required documented-negative-conclusion finding.
